facts.text: On July 1, 2025, the University of New Haven joined the Northeast Conference and began transitioning its 20 varsity sports to NCAA Division I.

sources.title: Fast Facts about the University of New Haven
sources.quote: On July 1, 2025, the University of New Haven became a member of the Northeast Conference (NEC) and began its transition to NCAA Division I during the 2025-26 academic year.

sources.title: Fast Facts about the University of New Haven
sources.quote: The University offers 20 varsity sports and we have approximately 730 student-athletes.
